complete_examples.text: Additionally, shrinkage of the cement gel can easily cause microcracks, which may be one of the reasons for the water-softening of the loose fill specimens.
Regardless of whether the basement is continuous or has voids, the stress–strain curves of the loose fill specimens exhibit creep and water-softening characteristics.
